name: Crenshaw Imperial Plaza
summary: Crenshaw Imperial Plaza is a spacious community shopping center in Inglewood featuring a diverse mix of retail stores, services, a grocery anchor, and multiple dining options. This well-rated neighborhood destination serves as a convenient one-stop shopping hub for local residents seeking everyday necessities and quick-service meals.
demographics: Crenshaw Imperial Plaza serves a diverse, predominantly middle-income community in the Inglewood area, with a strong representation of African American and Hispanic families. The trade area attracts value-conscious shoppers seeking everyday necessities, with household incomes typically ranging from $40,000 to $75,000 annually. Primary visitors include working families, young professionals, and multi-generational households who prioritize convenience and affordability in their shopping patterns. The center draws from a densely populated urban trade area within a 3-5 mile radius, serving as a neighborhood hub for grocery shopping, essential services, and quick-service dining.
description: Crenshaw Imperial Plaza stands as a vital community shopping destination in Inglewood, California, strategically located at the intersection of Crenshaw Boulevard and Imperial Highway. This spacious open-air plaza has served the diverse South Bay community for decades, evolving to meet the changing needs of local residents and families. The center offers a comprehensive mix of retail stores, essential services, and dining options anchored by a full-service grocery store that serves as the primary draw for daily shopping needs. Visitors can find a variety of fast-food outlets and restaurants providing convenient meal options, alongside retail stores offering everything from apparel to household goods. With a strong 4.3-star rating from over 5,000 reviews, Crenshaw Imperial Plaza has established itself as a reliable and accessible shopping destination that combines convenience, value, and community connection in the heart of Inglewood.
